$comment: The number each service op travels under on the service stream (wire-v1.md, *The service stream*).
WHY NUMBERS. A service record names its op in one u32 rather than by its name: the stream carries
audio parameter edits and storage writes at whatever rate content makes them, and a name per record
is bytes and a string compare for nothing. The price of numbers is drift between two halves, so both
halves are held to this file: the host's table in engine/crates/core/src/runtime/service_ops.rs by
a unit test that reads it, and the producer's (platforms/apple/WebContent/PerformancePlus/src/
service-ops.mjs) by the generator that stages the engine (scripts/gen-performance-plus-engine.py),
which stops the build on any difference.
RULES. Append only. A number is never reused and never renumbered, because a producer and a host
that disagree about one op's number call a different op with the right-looking arguments. An op
listed here must be classified async, command or sync in op-boundary.json; which of the three it
is decides whether it travels as a request, a command or a synchronous SERVICE call.
